fields.label: Print alert sounds
fields.help: Play a distinct tone on CoreBAR for a print failure, printer-reported print error, or completed print. Studio must stay connected.

connection.label: Printer
connection.title: Bambu printers
connection.setupHelp: Find the IP, serial and LAN access code in the printer network settings. The PC and printer need LAN access. Some firmware requires Developer Mode for controls.

fields.label: Printer model
fields.help: Choose the model for its widget illustration and nozzle labels. H2D uses left and right nozzle.

fields.label: Enable pause, resume, stop and light

studio.help: Choose a model in Manage printers for the printer illustration and nozzle presets. H2D shows left and right nozzle. Long job names scroll on one line. Swipe down on the unfolded widget to close; Back, tapping outside or activating the small handle also closes it. Connections and access codes stay on this PC.
